text:
Maya: FYI cron model-refresh failed in nightly (00:30 UTC). failing job: model-refresh-janitor. infra-bot alert below.

infra-bot: [ALERT] job model-refresh-janitor failed
status: CrashLoopBackOff
exit: 137 (OOM)
node: gpu-pool-12

Sam: can you paste the tail of the pod logs? suspect kvcache sync hit memory spike :thinking:

Maya: tail:
```
I0325 00:30:12.345 ModelRefreshService: starting refresh for model: redwood-1
... loading shards
E0325 00:30:45.678 Runtime: KVCACHE allocation failed: could not reserve 4.0GiB
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

Leo: hmm looks like kvcache allocation on shard 7. Was the nightly batch size changed? :eyes:

Jin: pinging @Sam — any recent commits to refresh config? I'll bisect if needed. What commit range / image tag for the cron image?

Sam: deploy tag is `ci-refresh-2026-03-25-7a2f`. previous good was `ci-refresh-2026-03-24-4b9c`.

Jin: ok I'll run a quick bisect across image builds. Maya can you try a manual rerun with reduced concurrency? Command:
```
kubectl -n cron delete pod model-refresh-janitor-<id>
./cron-runner --concurrency=2 --timeout=1800s
```

Maya: running manual rerun with --concurrency=2 now.

infra-bot: [ACTION] manual run started by Maya (run-id: 20260325-0045)

Maya: manual run started — progress logs look better so far. will report back.

Maya: manual run completed SUCCESS. heap peaked at 2.8GiB, no OOM.

Jin: if manual with concurrency=2 passes but nightly with concurrency=8 fails, looks like scaling/regression in allocator. I'll start a bisect on the image changes and also check recent jemalloc/allocator flags in the runtime.

Sam: created ticket INF-1247 to track: 'kvcache OOM for model-refresh when concurrency>4'. Assigned Jin. :white_check_mark:

Leo: can we add a short-term guard: cron should fallback to serialized refresh when mem usage > 3GiB? Ops can add it tomorrow.

Maya: noted. I'll also pin the nightly to previous good image for tonight.

Sam: thanks everyone. cc @eng-oncall if it recurs overnight.

Maya: marking thread resolved for now.
